Drawer Slides", 2022) and Jin (CN209374057U);Claim 10 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Ives (US4806881A), Sanus ("CFR2115, CFR2127, CFR2136, CFR2144 Instruction Manual", 2014), AI-Samman ("Comparative Study of Indoor Propagation Model Below and Above 6 GHz for SG Wireless Networks", 2019), Rockier.com ("Accuride 2109 75-1b. Drawer Slides", 2022) and Jin (CN209374057U) as applied to claim 1, in view of Leger ("How to Use a Function Generator", 2013);Claims 3-9 are objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.In this response, claims 1, 4, 6 and 10 have been amended. Claim 3 is cancelled without prejudice or disclaimer of subject matter. No new matter is believed to have been introduced by way of these amendments.Therefore, upon the entry of these amendments, claims 1 and 4-10 are now pending.Allowable SublteetMatter Applicant thanks the Examiner for indicating that claims 3-9 are objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.C'gm beefns Claims 1-3 and 4 are objected to because of informalities:In the Office Action, it is pointed out that Claim 1, lines 11-12, state "electrically; a storage" but should read -electrically; and a storage. Claim 3, lines 9-10, state "sleeve; a drive" but should read "sleeve; and a drive". Claim 4, lines 11-12, state "box; a set" but should read "box; and a set.In response, the Applicant has amended claims 1, 3 and 4.Accordingly, the Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the objection to the claims.Claim Rejections - 35 U.S.C. 103 Claim 1 is rejected under 35 US.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Ives (US4806881A) in view of Sanus ("CFR2115, C'FR2127, CFR2136, CFR2144 Instruction Manual", 2014) and AI-Sam man ("Comparative Study of Indoor Propagation Model Below and Above 6 GE1z for SG Wireless Networks", 2019) and further in view of Rockier.com (" Accuride 2109 75-lb. Drawer Slides", 2022) andJin (CN209374057U);Claim 10 is rejected under 35 U S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Ives (US4806881A), Sanus ("CFR2115, CFR2127, CFR2136, CFR2144 Instruction Manual", 2014), AI-Samman ("Comparative Study of Indoor Propagation Model Below and Above 6 GHz for SG Wireless Networks", 2019), Rockier.com ("Accuride 2109 75-lb. Drawer Slides".2022) and Jin (CN209374057U) as applied to claim 1, in view of Leger ("How to Use a Function Generator", 2013).Claim i has been amended, with all features of claim 3 having been introduced into claim 1.The Applicant thanks the Examiner for indicating that claims 3-9 are objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.The Applicant has amended independent claim 1 by incorporating the additional technical features of allowable claim 3, and thus amended independent claim 1 is patentable.Dependent claims 4-10 depend directly or indirectly from amended claim I and therefore are patentable also for at least the same reasons.CONCLUSIONIt is believed that all of the grounds of rejection have been properly traversed, accommodated, or rendered moot. The Applicant therefore respectfully requests that the Examiner reconsider and withdraw all presently outstanding rejections. It is believed that a full and complete response has been made to the outstanding Office Action and that the present application is in condition for allowance. Prompt and favorable reconsideration of this application is respectfully requested.Respectfully submitted, 12234 Shadow Creek Pkwy, Bldg 5 Unit 110, Pearland, TX 77584 By: /Jeenam Park.
